them: [Thu 2026-11-05 19:12 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
the router is a mikrotik, you can ssh in as admin@192.168.88.1, password is redwings44. only small reversible tweaks please, don't break the house internet
pclaw: Got it. I'll keep changes small and reversible.

them: [Thu 2026-11-05 09:40 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
here's the weather api key for the dashboard: wx_live_8f3k2LmQ91zTPa0v. stick it wherever it needs to go
pclaw: Added it to the dashboard's config on mp1 and the forecast tile is loading now.

them: [Fri 2026-11-06 20:05 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
is the minecraft server up yet?

pclaw: It's up on mp1. systemd unit minecraft.service (starts on boot, restarts on crash), world data in /var/lib/minecraft/world, nightly backups to /var/lib/minecraft/backups, port 25565 forwarded through the WireGuard box at 10.7.0.1, RCON on 25575. I wrote all of it down in ~/minecraft-server.txt, including how to add someone to the whitelist.

them: [Fri 2026-11-06 20:07 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
sick, I'll have the boys join tonight

them: [Mon 2026-11-02 15:30 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
what versions did the pc1 setup end up with
pclaw: Godot 4.7.2 at ~/.local/bin/godot and Blender 5.2.3 at ~/.local/bin/blender. The disk has 1.9T free and the GPU is on Vulkan. Export templates are still missing.

them: [Mon 2026-11-02 15:31 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
ok cool, I want pc1 to be the game build machine from now on

them: [Sat 2026-11-07 11:00 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
need a new office chair, back's been bugging me
pclaw: For your budget I'd go with the Steelcase Series 2. Good lumbar support and it's often on sale around $400.

them: [Sat 2026-11-07 11:04 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
hm maybe, I'll try some in person first

them: [Wed 2026-11-04 08:15 (America/Chicago, UTC-06:00)]
fyi don't message me before 9am unless it's actually urgent
pclaw: Noted. I'll hold anything non-urgent until 9.

notes:
- Lives in Chicago, Pilsen neighborhood
- Machines: mp1 (always-on Linux box), pc1 (gaming PC, Godot and Blender), mm1 (Mac mini)
